chunks: And from him, from Aḥmad al-Qarawī, from Abān, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī and Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, from Abī Jaʿfar and Abī ʿAbdillāh عليهما السلام, that they both said:
"If you do not know whether you have prayed one or two, then start over."

key_terms.فَاسْتَقْبِلْ: then start over; resume the prayer from its beginning
key_terms.لَمْ تَدْرِ: you do not know; indicating uncertainty or doubt

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts whether one has prayed one rakʿah or two in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer). If a person is uncertain whether they have prayed one rakʿah or two, they are instructed to begin the prayer anew.
